papers.title_en: Data-Driven Hamiltonian for Neural Optimal Control
papers.authors: Christopher A. Strong, Aswin Surya, Namhoon Cho, Jason J. Choi, Claire J. Tomlin
papers.evidence: 将Hamilton-Jacobi最优控制理论与数据驱动学习结合用于控制
papers.tldr: 强化学习最优控制常依赖大量数据，且对分布外状态动作缺乏保证。本文基于Hamilton-Jacobi框架提出数据驱动哈密顿量DDH，仅需Lipschitz常数等少量先验即可量化未覆盖区域不确定性并给出性能保证。针对高维系统，引入物理信息值函数近似，用DDH生成最坏情况虚构轨迹训练。在LQR上接近最优且样本更少；月球着陆器上最优性差距较CQL/FQL小3倍以上，并以约37倍更少样本匹配SAC。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a prominent data-driven approach to optimal control, but often requires substantial amounts of data and provides limited guarantees when encountering out-of-distribution state-action pairs. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach grounded in the well-established Hamilton-Jacobi framework in optimal control theory. Rather than requiring an explicit analytical model of the system dynamics to evaluate the Hamiltonian, we replace this with a data-driven Hamiltonian (DDH), which we generalize to a broad class of optimal control problems. In contrast to standard RL approaches, the DDH provides a principled mechanism, requiring only minimal prior system information such as a Lipschitz constant, for quantifying and accounting for uncertainty in regions not covered by the data, enabling the derivation of controllers with performance guarantees. Additional prior system knowledge, when available, can be readily incorporated to improve performance. For high-dimensional systems, we further introduce a physics-informed neural approximation of the value function, trained using a novel procedure that generates worst-case fictitious rollouts evaluated through the DDH. On an LQR problem, the DDH reaches near-optimal cost on every dataset we test, including random data on which offline RL methods remain far from optimal, and needs far fewer samples than online RL. On a nonlinear lunar lander benchmark, the DDH achieves an optimality gap to a trajectory-optimization reference more than $3\times$ smaller than CQL and FQL, and matches the performance of SAC with approximately $37\times$ fewer samples. These results establish the DDH as a promising framework for data-driven optimal control, particularly in settings where available data are limited in quantity or quality.

papers.title_en: Whole-Body Humanoid Control via Stochastic Motion Tokenization
papers.authors: Michael Drolet, Oleg Arenz, Jan Peters
papers.evidence: 以简洁运动标记表征驱动跟踪策略的人形机器人全身运动控制
papers.tldr: 人形机器人复杂全身运动难以用速度指令和有限未来信息的跟踪策略完成。本文用随机运动分词器把运动压缩为离散token，由高层控制器按行为标签或文本生成参考并条件化跟踪策略。在Unitree G1上，分词重建优于FSQ与VQ-VAE，物理机器人完成16.8秒舞蹈、格斗、行走及35秒格斗转舞蹈序列。该工作为可生成、可切换的全身控制提供了简洁离散接口。
papers.abstract_en: While velocity-commanded RL policies are effective for controlling quadrupeds, they are a limited interface for humanoids that need to perform complex whole-body motions. Furthermore, RL tracking policies for whole-body motions typically have limited information about the desired future motion, preventing them from performing controlled deviations to achieve long-term task success; such information is particularly relevant when a controller must prepare for transitions between behaviors. We address these challenges using concise motion representations that can be generated by a high-level controller, given a behavior label or text command. These representations can be fed directly into a tracking policy to provide a detailed motion reference. Our method exhibits a high degree of flexibility in performing real-world robot motions such as dancing, fighting, or walking based on conditional information. At matched capacity, our adopted stochastic motion tokenizer reconstructs motions from the Unitree G1 at a level that exceeds state-of-the-art approaches such as finite scalar quantization (FSQ) and the vector-quantized autoencoder (VQ-VAE). The resulting discrete interface conditions whole-body tracking policies that execute generated dance, fight, and walk motions lasting 16.8 s each and a 35 s fight-to-dance sequence on a physical Unitree G1.

papers.title_en: HC2Robot: Hyper-Connection Transformers with Predicted Foresight for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Parkour
papers.authors: Wenhao Xu, Yanheng Mai, Yifei Fu, Nan Zheng, Yanbo Zhou, Zirui Huang, Mingsheng Ling, Xinjue Wang, Renjing Xu
papers.evidence: 基于强化学习的感知式人形机器人跑酷与不对称演员-评论家
papers.tldr: 人形跑酷需在不连续地形上预判落脚点与全身动作，但非对称actor-critic中critic训练可用特权信息、部署actor仅靠机载感知，形成信息鸿沟。HC2Robot用预测前瞻模块从可部署观测预测每只脚下次触地的时机、位置与支撑质量，把特权监督转为可部署潜表示；再以Hyper-Connection Transformer多流路由增强时序推理，并用未来运动预测头做短时先验正则。在楼梯、沟壑、高台和斜坡上仿真平均通行成功率达97.60%，安全落脚率优于强基线，表明无需特权运行时传感也能提升多地形人形跑酷。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid parkour requires robots to reason about future footholds and whole-body motions over highly discontinuous terrain. We revisit the information asymmetry in asymmetric actor-critic learning for perceptive humanoid locomotion: the critic exploits privileged simulator signals during training, whereas the deployable actor operates solely from onboard perception. We argue that the key is not exposing privileged information to the actor, but learning a deployable approximation of it to narrow the information gap between training and deployment. We present HC2Robot, a deployable perceptive humanoid parkour framework consisting of a Predicted Foresight Module (PFM) and a Hyper-Connection (HC) Transformer. PFM predicts from deployable observations the policy-conditioned timing, location, and support quality of each foot's next touchdown event, converting privileged supervision into a deployable latent representation that provides the actor with predicted touchdown information without privileged runtime sensing. The HC Transformer further enhances temporal reasoning through learnable multi-stream routing, while a future motion prediction head provides short-horizon motion priors for regularization. Across stairs, gaps, high platforms, and slopes, HC2Robot achieves a mean simulated traversal success rate of 97.60% and consistently higher safe foothold rates than strong perceptive locomotion baselines, supporting improved traversal performance and geometric foothold support under deployable sensing.

papers.title_en: Hyperparameter and Neural Architecture Search via Evolutionary Optimization for Reinforcement Learning: HPNAS-RL
papers.authors: Nihal Acharya Adde, Hanno Gottschalk
papers.evidence: 基于进化多目标优化的神经架构搜索
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶强化学习策略设计依赖人工调参和网络结构试错，现有NAS较少联合优化训练动态。本文提出双分支进化框架HPNAS-RL，在多目标搜索中并行进化离散网络结构与连续超参数，并用并行评估和教师-学生策略迁移加速收敛。在高保真驾驶仿真中，联合NAS-HPO稳定优于单独NAS，获得更高奖励、更少参数和更好稳定性。结果表明联合优化模型结构与训练动态有助于可扩展、有效的RL智能体设计。
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we propose a dual-branch evolutionary framework that simultaneously performs Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) for Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Autonomous Driving (AD) tasks. While NAS has shown strong potential in automating architecture design for Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), its application to RL remains limited, especially in scenarios that require joint optimization of architectural and training dynamics. Building on our prior work on Evolutionary Multi-Objective NAS (EMNAS), the proposed framework evolves discrete network architectures and continuous hyperparameters in parallel under a unified multi-objective search strategy. In this setup, NAS targets the convolutional layers of the RL policy network - responsible for visual feature extraction, while HPO focuses on optimizing critical RL hyperparameters. To accelerate convergence and improve generalization, we incorporate parallel evaluation and a teacher-student policy transfer mechanism. Experiments in a high-fidelity driving simulator show that the joint NAS-HPO framework consistently outperforms standalone NAS, yielding policies with higher rewards, fewer parameters, and improved stability. These results highlight the benefits of jointly optimizing model structure and training dynamics for scalable and effective RL agent design.

papers.title_en: Local Koopman modes of saddle-point diffusions: exact singular functions and a data-driven estimator
papers.authors: Xuehao Ding
papers.evidence: 面向随机非线性动力系统的局部Koopman算子理论
papers.tldr: 针对鞍点扩散中相干集与随机 Koopman 算子奇异函数缺乏局部解析理论的问题，本文在不动点邻域构造鞍点的局部理论。通过 Doob h-变换对不逃逸事件条件化，证明所需 h 为代数 Riccati 方程的唯一镇定解，并给出由 Hermite 多项式与 h 函数乘积表示的闭式慢模。由此提出在条件轨迹上做典型相关分析的数据驱动估计器；单一不稳定方向主导时首模即反应坐标，局部恢复稳定流形与 committor。该工作把相干集、过渡路径理论、线性控制 Riccati 解及生成扩散模型的时间反演动力学联系起来。
papers.abstract_en: Coherent sets-regions of phase space that resist mixing-organize transport in stochastic dynamical systems and are encoded in the leading singular functions of the stochastic Koopman operator. These are typically computed numerically and globally; a local, analytic theory near a fixed point has been missing, although fixed points and the transitions between them organize the flow. We supply the local theory for a saddle, the transition state through which probability flows between basins. Naively the construction fails-probability escapes along unstable directions, the invariant measure is non-normalizable, the singular functions leave $L^2$, and singular values exceed one. We show that conditioning on non-escape (a Doob's $h$-transform) repairs this; that the required $h$ is the unique stabilizing solution of an algebraic Riccati equation; and that the resulting slow modes decay at the escape rate along the unstable manifold. We obtain these modes in closed form-products of Hermite polynomials in canonical coordinates times the $h$-function-and use their unitary structure to derive a data-driven estimator: canonical correlation analysis on conditioned trajectories. When a single unstable direction dominates, the leading mode is the reaction coordinate, locally recovering the stable manifold and committor of transition-path theory. The construction connects coherent sets to transition-path theory, to the stabilizing Riccati solution of linear control, and to the time-reversed dynamics of generative diffusion models.

papers.title_en: Balanced Active Subspaces for Optimal Control via Trajectory Optimization
papers.authors: Emmanuel S. Ameh, Samuel E. Otto
papers.evidence: 通过轨迹优化为HJB最优控制进行模型降维
papers.tldr: 针对高维非线性系统求解HJB方程的价值函数维度灾难，提出BASOC降维框架。该方法用轨迹优化与Pontryagin极小值原理采集局部最优轨迹上的状态和协态数据，构建状态与梯度协方差矩阵并做平衡，得到价值函数的斜投影近似。在线性二次情形下，BASOC等价于最优闭环快照平衡法；在POD和平衡截断表现不佳的三维非线性系统及复Ginzburg-Landau方程上验证了可行性与扩展潜力。
papers.abstract_en: The curse of dimensionality associated with solving the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation for the value function remains a key obstacle for real-time optimal feedback control of high-dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems. This is especially severe in aerospace applications such as relaminarizing unsteady turbulent flows and recovering from aerodynamic stall where nonlinear dynamics play a significant role. We introduce Balanced Active Subspaces for Optimal Control (BASOC), a model reduction framework which seeks to find directions in state space along which the value function is most sensitive, and the distribution of states exhibits maximum variance along optimal trajectories. BASOC leverages trajectory optimization and the Pontryagin minimum principle to obtain state and co-state (value function gradient) data along locally optimal trajectories for constructing state and gradient covariance matrices. Balancing these matrices provides an oblique projection for approximating the value function, which can also be used to construct reduced-order models and surrogate feedback control laws. We show that for linear-quadratic optimal control problems, BASOC becomes equivalent to a snapshot method for initial condition balancing of the optimally controlled closed-loop realization. The framework is demonstrated on a nonlinear three-dimensional system where POD and balanced truncation are known to perform poorly, and on the nonlinear complex Ginzburg-Landau equation to demonstrate feasibility for larger-scale systems.

papers.title_en: Optimizing Physical Neural Networks through Device Variable Selection
papers.authors: Sjoerd van den Belt, Manuel Escudero, Mohamadreza Zolfagharinejad, Wilfred G. van der Wiel, Nikolaos Alachiotis
papers.evidence: 将信号与器件变量的路由作为可训练参数以优化网络结构
papers.tldr: 物理神经网络用器件物理实现高效推理，但破损同构架构中信号到器件变量的映射仍待优化。本文把信号与物理器件输入变量之间的路由设为可训练参数，并用Gumbel-Softmax训练离散分类分布来选择器件变量。在实验校准的多变量电子RNPU模型上，MNIST小CNN准确率从94.5%升至96.9%，CIFAR-10从62.8%升至68.0%，且额外推理开销可忽略。该方法利用破损同构架构的诱导偏差，为更高效的物理神经网络推理提供了新途径。
papers.abstract_en: Physical neural networks (PNNs) leverage device physics in electronics, optics, and related domains to enable energy-efficient neural networks. Broken-isomorphism PNNs replace linear operations with multivariate physical transformations, modifying how input signals are mapped to device variables. We exploit network architectures emerging from these mappings by treating the routing between signals and input variables of physical devices as trainable parameters. This approach expands device-level tunability of the physical transformations while, at the system level, demonstrating improved expressivity of PNNs with negligible additional inference overhead. This discrete routing is optimized by training a categorical distribution using Gumbel-Softmax reparametrization. We evaluate this approach using experimentally calibrated differentiable models of multivariate electronic RNPUs for MNIST and CIFAR-10 classification. Using variable selection, we improve the MNIST classification accuracy for a small CNN model from 94.5% to 96.9% and the accuracy of CIFAR-10 from 62.8% to 68.0%. Our method uniquely leverages the induced biases of broken-isomorphism PNN architectures, paving the way towards more efficient physics-based neural network inference.

papers.title_en: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
papers.authors: Yang Liu, Jiacheng Liu, Hengtao Li, Yuheng Huang, Zijian Yang, Ji Dai, Maoxin Wang, Yi Gao, Qishen Wang, Baohua Yin, Peiyang Li, Shuanghao Bai, Mingyang Sun, Pengxiang Ding, Jianqin Yin, Lixin Yang, Donglin Wang
papers.evidence: 预测潜在运动token以驱动全身控制的人形通用视觉-语言-动作模型
papers.tldr: 将视觉-语言-动作模型扩展到人形机器人面临全身控制与真实演示采集成本高的难题。HuGe利用超2000小时第一人称人类与机器人数据预训练，通过预测潜在运动token和手部控制信号驱动全身控制器。采用第一人称预训练、人形适配与下游微调三阶段流程，并用仿真回放构造伪本体状态、重渲染调整手臂外观以促进跨本体迁移。该方法在HumanoidArena达到最优，并在Unitree G1真机抓放任务中验证第一人称演示增强的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios. Although egocentric human demonstrations provide a complementary source of task experience, differences in visual embodiment and missing robot proprioception complicate transfer to humanoid policies. To address these challenges, we introduce HuGe, a family of Humanoid Generalist VLAs pre-trained on over 2,000 hours of egocentric human and robot data. Specifically, HuGe employs three existing representative VLA architectures to predict latent motion tokens for a pretrained whole-body controller, together with hand-control signals. Based on this, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline that combines egocentric pre-training, humanoid adaptation, and downstream fine-tuning. To facilitate transfer across embodiments, we construct pseudo-proprioceptive states through simulation playback during pre-training and modify arm appearance in egocentric observations through re-rendering during downstream fine-tuning. With this pipeline, HuGe achieves the state-of-the-art on simulation benchmark HumanoidArena. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 indicate that augmenting robot demonstrations with visually adapted egocentric demonstrations significantly increases success on a pick-and-drop task.

papers.title_en: Physical Canvas: A Vision Tactile World Model For Robot Policy Evaluation And Learning
papers.authors: Zebin Xing, Yuhang Zheng, Yupeng Zheng, Yichen Zhang, Zichen Li, Shangqing Zhou, Yujie Zang, Yuchen Liu, Zhongpu Xia, Haoran Li, Qichao Zhang
papers.evidence: 作为交互式仿真器的动作条件世界模型用于机器人策略评估
papers.tldr: 机器人策略评估与后训练依赖昂贵真实交互，视觉世界模型又常忽略接触动力学而给出不可靠反馈。PhysCanvas将多视角RGB、触觉图像、标记位移、任务状态与动作统一到视觉空间，共享视频VAE与生成骨干，并用运动图像做空间对齐动作条件。其一致性后训练借助场景、模态与状态奖励模型约束生成，使世界模型成功率与真实成功率的相关均值从0.602升至0.885，并将π0.5真实成功率从59.1%提至70.8%。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $π_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/.

papers.title_en: Value-Rectified Distillation for Flow-based Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Ke Jiang, Wen Jiang, Yoshinobu Kawahara, Xiaoyang Tan
papers.evidence: 面向强化学习的价值引导离线策略蒸馏
papers.tldr: 针对离线强化学习蒸馏Flow Matching行为策略时出现的OOD模式平均问题，标准蒸馏会在多模态数据上跨模式插值，使动作落入无效区域。本文提出Value-Rectified Distillation（VRD），将离线策略蒸馏重构为值引导的生成轨迹对齐问题，并通过动态耦合机制修正流动力学、解耦行为模式以分离高价值动作。作者给出VRD-Q与VRD-R两种实例：前者用值分位数过滤低价值行为，后者在潜空间几何隔离高价值轨迹。在D4RL、OGBench和Minari的连续控制与规划任务上，VRD优于现有生成式基线，尤其多模态非专家数据。
papers.abstract_en: We aim to address the problem of Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Mode Averaging, a critical problem that emerges when distilling Flow Matching (FM) based behavior policies in offline Reinforcement Learning (RL): When learning over multi-modal datasets, standard distillation inadvertently forces the policy to interpolate across different behavioral modes, causing the generated actions to collapse into invalid, OOD regions. To resolve this, we propose Value-Rectified Distillation (VRD), a novel framework that reformulates offline policy distillation as a value-guided generative trajectory alignment problem. By employing a dynamic coupling mechanism, VRD actively rectifies flow dynamics to explicitly decouple distinct behavioral modes, cleanly isolating high-value actions. Specifically, we instantiate VRD through two complementary algorithms: VRD-Q, which utilizes value-quantile behavior distillation to statistically filter out low-value behaviors, and VRD-R, which reorganizes the latent space to geometrically isolate high-value generative trajectories from the FM-based behavior policy. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that VRD improves existing generative baselines across diverse continuous control and planning tasks on the D4RL, OGBench, and Minari benchmarks, especially over those multi-modal, non-expert datasets.

papers.title_en: Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor Critic for Decentralized LLM Collaboration
papers.authors: Tianle Chen, Shuo Liu, Christopher Amato
papers.evidence: 信念条件下的多智能体actor-critic训练
papers.tldr: 针对去中心化LLM协作中预定义流程限制效率与扩展性的问题，本文提出BCMAAC，一种信念条件化的多智能体actor-critic方法，通过维护对上下文信息的信念来辅助训练。在Minecraft、网页搜索和工具使用任务上，该方法提升了任务表现与协作行为，尤其在上下文更丰富的多轮任务中优势明显。
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has explored optimizing LLM collaboration through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), but many approaches still rely on predefined workflows, limiting efficiency and scalability. Decentralized LLM collaboration is challenging because agents execute independently with limited communication, share a joint objective, and must infer useful information from communication traces. In this paper, we propose BCMAAC, a Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor-Critic method that maintains beliefs over contextual information and uses them to facilitate training. Experiments on Minecraft game-playing, web searching and tool-using tasks show that BCMAAC improves task performance and collaborative behavior compared to naive actor-critic baselines. The improvements are particularly pronounced in multi-turn tasks with richer contextual information, where belief modeling provides a clear advantage.

papers.title_en: Enhancing Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Motion Planning via Task Decomposition
papers.authors: Yuanzhi He, Victor Romero-Cano, Jiayu Xu, Juan David Hernández, Gualtiero Colombo
papers.evidence: 带选择性critic参数迁移与奖励重设计的深度强化学习
papers.tldr: 针对带障碍机器人操作任务在DRL中收敛慢、性能不足的问题，提出任务分解框架，将迁移学习与奖励重设计结合。方法仅跨相关任务迁移critic首层参数，并通过分阶段子目标提供更密集优化信号。PyBullet Panda上Push障碍成功率0.83，较TQC提升约7.8%；Slide达0.95，较SAC提升约11%，并显著缩短训练。该框架提升障碍场景效率与鲁棒性，并在真实Franka FR3上完成可行性演示。
papers.abstract_en: Training robotic manipulation policies in simulation is widely adopted due to safety and cost efficiency; however, tasks involving obstacles remain under-performing and often converge slowly under Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL). To address this challenge, we propose a task decomposition framework for DRL that integrates Transfer Learning (TL) with Reward Redesign (RR) to improve learning efficiency and robustness in obstacle environments. The TL strategy selectively transfers only the first-layer critic parameters across structurally related tasks, since that layer captures general state--action representations while deeper layers encode reward- and obstacle-specific value geometry; RR decomposes tasks into staged sub-objectives to provide denser optimization signals. Experiments on the PyBullet Panda platform show consistent gains in obstacle settings. On Push with obstacle, our method achieves $0.83 \pm 0.05$, outperforming the strongest baseline (Truncated Quantile Critics (TQC), $0.77 \pm 0.06$) by approximately $7.8\%$. On Slide with obstacle, performance reaches $0.95 \pm 0.02$, exceeding Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) ($0.84 \pm 0.06$) by about $11\%$ success rates. In addition to higher final performance, forward transfer reduces convergence time by up to $70\%$ in obstacle tasks, and RR shortens sparse-reward Pick-and-Place training from roughly $0.75$M to $0.20$M steps ($\approx73\%$ reduction). The best policy is deployed on a real Franka Emika FR3 robot as a qualitative feasibility demonstration.

papers.title_en: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Using Routed Ensembles and Trajectory Attribution
papers.authors: Zhenshuo Zhang, Ruoxuan Xiong, Hongyang R. Zhang
papers.evidence: 多目标强化学习策略优化与遗憾界
papers.tldr: 多目标强化学习需在冲突目标间权衡策略，目标冲突程度直接影响样本效率。作者提出目标冲突系数并给出在线近优遗憾界，设计路由集成策略学习，维护少量基策略并动态路由轨迹；同时用核代理轨迹归因捕捉轨迹间非线性协同与拮抗。在Meta-World与MO-Gymnasium上平均性能提升4.3%，归因相关性较基线提高50%，用于轨迹选择时奖励提升27%。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-objective reinforcement learning is a fundamental problem for modern AI, with applications spanning post-training, reasoning models, and robotic control. A central challenge is to learn policies that balance competing objectives, such as helpfulness versus honesty in safety and alignment, or speed versus energy in robotics. The optimal policy can vary sharply with objective-weighting combinations, and the extent of this variation depends crucially on the degree of conflict among objectives, making per-preference policy learning sample-inefficient. In this paper, we introduce objective-conflict coefficients and derive near-optimal regret bounds for online settings using this measure, thereby quantifying the impact of misalignment on learning efficiency. Then, we design routed ensemble policy learning, an algorithm that maintains a small set of basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories to the policy with the highest potential reward. Finally, we consider trajectory selection as another approach to mitigate objective conflict, and design a kernel surrogate trajectory attribution algorithm that estimates how feedback signals from a set of trajectories influence policy learning on other trajectories. The kernel can capture nonlinear interactions such as synergy and antagonism between trajectories. We evaluate our approach across diverse environments and benchmarks: routed ensembles improve average performance by 4.3% over baselines for online environments from Meta-World and MO-Gymnasium, and kernel surrogate attribution improves correlation with leave-one-out analysis over existing baselines by 50%. When applied to trajectory selection, kernel-based attribution yields a 27% improvement in reward over baseline attribution methods.

papers.title_en: FOCUS: Active Critic Learning for Long-Horizon Language Model Agents
papers.authors: Zhengping Jiang, William Jurayj, Liaoyaqi Wang, Chunsheng Zuo, Anqi Liu, Benjamin Van Durme
papers.evidence: 用评论家价值估计与TD优势进行强化学习信用分配
papers.tldr: 长程语言模型智能体在稀疏结果奖励下难以把信用分配给早期动作，学到的critic估值不准，而用重复续写采样估计中间价值成本高昂。FOCUS提出选择性分支的主动critic学习：rollout控制器从预期最能降低估值误差的状态采样续写，用TD(λ)优势为状态间片段打分，并把这些证据作为critic训练目标，同时以模块化上下文管理接口解耦上下文管理与采样分配。在Qwen3.5-9B上，BrowseComp-Plus较最强基线提升7.2分（55.4 vs 48.2），DeonticBench提升4.1分。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse outcome rewards make it difficult for long-horizon language-model agents to assign credit to earlier actions. Learned critics provide value estimates for intermediate states, but these estimates can be inaccurate, while estimating intermediate values with repetitive continuation samples from points within a trajectory incurs substantial costs. To mitigate these issues, we introduce FOCUS, an RL method that uses selective branching to help the critic network learn its value estimator. The rollout controller facilitates active learning for the critic by sampling continuations from states that are expected to most reduce the critic's estimation error. These refined value estimates then score the segment between consecutive states with a TD($λ$) advantage, while the sampled evidence supplies training targets for the critic. FOCUS supports long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning through a modular context-management interface that decouples context management from rollout allocation. Our experiments show that using compaction-induced segment boundaries for value estimation and credit assignment, FOCUS outperforms GRPO and VinePPO with matched per-step generation budgets on legal reasoning, deep search, and code localization benchmarks, improving held-out accuracy at Qwen3.5-9B scale by 7.2 points over the strongest baseline on BrowseComp-Plus (55.4 vs. 48.2) and by 4.1 points on DeonticBench (56.5 vs. 52.4).

papers.title_en: Data-Driven Stochastic Control of Delayed Air-Conditioning Systems
papers.authors: Christian Bayer, Raul Tempone, Leon Wilkosz
papers.evidence: 基于回归的离散动态规划求解随机最优控制
papers.tldr: 工业空调系统从停机到运行存在延迟激活效应，使受控动态呈非马尔可夫结构，给随机最优控制带来困难。作者在嵌套状态-控制网格上提出基于回归的离散动态规划算法，并给出理想化时间离散问题收敛到连续时间值函数的概率证明。基于标定的多维预测跟踪Ornstein-Uhlenbeck模型的数值实验验证了方法有效性。该工作为延迟空调系统的数据驱动随机控制提供了可计算框架与收敛保障。
papers.abstract_en: We consider a stochastic optimal control problem arising in the operation of industrial air-conditioning systems with delayed activation effects. The delayed transition between inactive and operational regimes induces a non-Markovian structure in the controlled dynamics. We derive a regression-based discrete dynamic programming algorithm on nested state-control grids. We give a probabilistic proof of convergence of the idealized time-discrete dynamic programming problem to the continuous-time value function. Numerical experiments based on calibrated multidimensional forecast-tracking Ornstein--Uhlenbeck models illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

papers.title_en: Learning Multi-Phase Robot Loco-Manipulation via Phase-Conditioned Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Simone Manni, Annika Wollschläger, Dario Bellicoso, Abel Gawel, Marco Hutter, Simon Le Cleac'h, Jan Brüdigam
papers.evidence: 面向足式与人形机器人的PPO全身移动操作策略
papers.tldr: 复杂长时程全身移动操作需在单任务中完成蹲伏、抓取和行走等多阶段动作；现有方法依赖人体运动数据与人形平台，限制硬件通用性且数据处理开销大。本文扩展PPO，引入阶段条件critic、阶段门控奖励和多阶段重置课程，并以解耦分层控制分离底层平衡与高层阶段执行。在Unitree G1和加装机械臂的Spot上验证多阶段技能，消融支持关键设计。该方法仅靠环境交互学习复杂行为，并将高层任务结构直接注入策略优化。
papers.abstract_en: Complex whole-body loco-manipulation requires executing diverse maneuvers, such as crouching, grasping, and locomotion, within a single long-horizon task. While performing simple pick-and-place behaviors is well-established, scaling to complex, long-horizon tasks remains difficult. Currently, this challenge is addressed by relying on human motion data and correspondingly humanoid platforms, which limits platform independence and introduces substantial data processing overhead. Instead, we extend proximal policy optimization (PPO) to train a single policy for multi-phase tasks across diverse robotic hardware, leveraging prior task structure to shape behavior. Our method adapts PPO using a phase-conditioned critic, phase-gated reward functions, and a multi-phase reset curriculum to guide exploration. To support varied hardware, we employ a decoupled hierarchical control architecture that separates lower-level balancing dynamics from high-level phase execution. We demonstrate multi-stage loco-manipulation skills on hardware on both the Unitree G1 and a Boston Dynamics Spot equipped with a manipulator arm, and validate our design choices through ablations. Our approach enables the acquisition of complex loco-manipulation behaviors purely through environment interaction while directly incorporating high-level task structure into policy learning.

papers.title_en: Bridging Exploration and Loss of Plasticity in On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Andrea Vasco Grieco, Evelyn D'Elia, Edoardo Caldarelli, Raffaello Camoriano
papers.evidence: PPO策略优化与可塑性丧失分析
papers.tldr: 深度强化学习常出现“可塑性丧失”（LoP），即策略难以从新数据中持续适应学习，但其因果机制与几何条件仍不清晰。论文聚焦连续动作中常用的PPO与各向同性高斯策略，系统分析策略标准差σ对LoP的影响并给出理论解释。实验发现σ显著调节LoP程度，同时可解释常见缓解技术的有效性。作者在标准基准和7自由度机械臂真实部署中验证，为连接探索与可塑性丧失提供新视角。
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have been observed to lose the ability to adaptively learn from new data, a phenomenon termed Loss of Plasticity (LoP). While many metrics have been shown to correlate with it, the causal mechanisms and the geometric conditions from which it can arise have not been clearly identified. We analyze LoP in Proximal Policy Optimization with isotropic Gaussian policies, the state-of-the-art formulation for many continuous action spaces in RL. We report multiple metrics which characterize the effect that the policy standard deviation $σ$ has on LoP, and we also suggest related explanations for the effectiveness of widely adopted LoP mitigation techniques. We observe a significant effect of $σ$ on the extent of LoP, and accompany this with both theoretical and experimental supporting arguments. Our experimental validation consists of LoP benchmark evaluations against standard baselines as well as real-world policy deployment on a 7-DoF robotic arm.

papers.title_en: Repulsive Population Policy Gradients for Behaviorally Diverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Saeed Hedayatian, Harsh Shah, Celine Mneimneh, Stefanos Nikolaidis
papers.evidence: 改造PPO以联合优化多样化高质量策略种群
papers.tldr: 质量-多样性强化学习需找到行为多样且高性能的策略，但现有方法多依赖进化算子，策略与行为空间变大时成本高。RePPO将PPO扩展到紧凑种群联合优化，用依赖种群、动态塑形的奖励驱动多样探索。连续控制上取得较优质量-多样性权衡，并在像素任务与LLM微调中保持质量、显著提升多样性。这表明直接优化紧凑种群可为复杂域提供可扩展的QD-RL方案。
papers.abstract_en: The goal of Quality-Diversity Reinforcement Learning (QD-RL) is to find a population of high-performing policies that solve a decision-making problem in diverse ways. Despite recent progress, QD-RL methods predominantly rely on evolutionary operators--including black-box optimizers, mutations, and crossovers--to facilitate exploration and induce diversity. Scaling these methods becomes increasingly costly as policies and behavior spaces grow larger. Building on the Soft QD view of quality-diversity optimization, we introduce \textbf{Re}pulsive \textbf{P}opulation \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (\textbf{RePPO}), which adapts PPO to jointly optimize a compact population of diverse, high-quality policies using a population-dependent, dynamically shaped reward. On standard continuous-control tasks, RePPO achieves a strong quality-diversity tradeoff compared with state-of-the-art QD-RL methods. Ablations further characterize this tradeoff by examining how each component affects individual quality and collective diversity. To assess RePPO's scalability, we extend our evaluation to learning from pixels and fine-tuning large language models. In pixel-based tasks, where large policies make most traditional QD-RL methods infeasible, RePPO maintains quality on par with standard PPO while achieving substantially higher diversity. Its successful application to language model fine-tuning further demonstrates, for the first time, that QD-RL methods can scale to this domain. Together, these results show that directly optimizing compact populations with RePPO provides a scalable approach to QD-RL across increasingly complex domains.

papers.title_en: Variational Optimal Control for Diffusion Guidance
papers.authors: Ruoyu Wang, Xinyi Ye, Yunshuo Shi, Liangyu Yuan, Beier Zhu, Chi Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于KL正则终端奖励与Doob变换的变分最优控制
papers.tldr: 扩散模型推理时引导与奖励微调往往割裂，本文提出共享雅可比回拉的变分控制框架，将终端奖励最大化与路径KL惩罚统一。该框架导出状态空间VOG，并以端点蒸馏摊销为DVOC。ImageNet上VOG把DiT-XL/2的FID在250步从2.27降至2.04、25步从7.58降至4.44；DVOC在Z-Image-Turbo上20次更新提升HPSv3++及四个留出评估器。其意义在于用共同几何原理连接推理控制与奖励适应。
papers.abstract_en: We present a variational control framework that connects sampling-time guidance and reward-based model adaptation through a shared Jacobian pullback. Starting from terminal reward maximization with a path-space KL penalty, the Gibbs variational principle and Doob transform yield a correction to the generative dynamics. A local denoising approximation exposes the pullback that transports output preferences to the controlled variable. This construction gives Variational Optimal Guidance (VOG) in state space and extends to Distilled Variational Optimal Control (DVOC) by amortizing locally improved endpoints into model parameters. The resulting controls share a local variational rule: VOG acts through the denoising Jacobian, while DVOC realizes the parameter pullback by endpoint distillation. Under a linear MMSE model, VOG's exact correction lies in the data subspace. On ImageNet, VOG reduces DiT-XL/2 FID from 2.27 to 2.04 at 250 sampling steps and from 7.58 to 4.44 at 25 steps. After 20 updates on Z-Image-Turbo, DVOC improves HPSv3++ and four held-out evaluator scores over the untrained model, with the highest corresponding means among the trained methods compared. These results connect inference-time control and reward adaptation through a common geometric principle.

papers.title_en: Tokens of Motion: Primitive Motion Learning for Human-Humanoid Skill Transfer
papers.authors: Hanwen Ren, Meng Zheng, Wenzhe Cui, Benjamin Planche, Zhongpai Gao, Anwesa Choudhuri, Terrence Chen, Ziyan Wu
papers.evidence: 面向人-人形技能迁移的基元运动学习
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作模型依赖仅成功数据的模仿学习，缺少纠错信号，微小执行误差会迅速累积为不可恢复的分布外失败。为此提出AFIL，利用预训练VLA在线生成失败轨迹，联合训练共享视觉语言主干的双动作生成器，并在采样时依据成功与失败分布距离自适应施加负引导。域内域外、短时与长时机器人操作实验显示，该方法持续提升任务成功率与鲁棒性。其意义在于将失败轨迹转化为可扩展的自适应负指导，以较小参数开销增强VLA策略可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising paradigm for scalable robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on success-only behavioral cloning leaves them brittle; lacking corrective training signals, minor execution errors rapidly compound into unrecoverable, out-of-distribution failures. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning (AFIL), an end-to-end framework that leverages failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance for diffusion- and flow-based VLA policies. AFIL uses a pretrained VLA to generate failure rollouts online, avoiding the need for handcrafted failure-mode design or human-in-the-loop recovery. It then jointly trains Dual Action Generators (DAGs) for successful and failed behaviors while sharing a common vision-language backbone, enabling efficient failure-aware policy learning with limited parameter overhead. During sampling, the failure generator adaptively steers action generation away from failure-prone regions and toward more reliable success modes, with guidance strength determined by the per-diffusion-step distance between success and failure distributions. Experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain robotic manipulation tasks, covering both short- and long-horizon settings, show that AFIL consistently improves task success rates and robustness over existing VLA baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness, efficiency, and generality.
